Help me protect my business
With coverages for an array of industries, The Hanover is here to keep your business protected.
We offer a variety of coverage for businesses across many industries.

Keep your business protected with professional liability coverage from The Hanover. With protection for a variety of professionals, our professional liability coverage provides protection for defense costs and settlement payments for claims that your firms’ work or advice was inadequate, contained errors, or failed to meet specifications.
Learn about our industry-specific professional liability solutions and how they can be tailored to fit your business.
The Hanover offers a variety of tools and resources, as well as the services of a network of preferred service providers, to help you mitigate the risks faced by your business.
Our industry-leading claim services and 24/7 reporting help you get back to business quickly. If you ever need to make a claim, you'll be glad you have The Hanover.
Never did I feel our claim was just another claim number on the never-ending pile of claims.
